Warming the slight chill in your eyes with the remnants of warmth in my heart.

58499.synopsis:
【Detailed Appraisal】Armed only with support skills and lacking combat abilities, I was en route to a dungeon for the first time when I came across a destitute young girl at the entrance.

Lately, my childhood friend has been acting strange………no wait, I don’t think it’s strange, I think she just simply made her high school debut.

And ever since my parents left for overseas work after I graduated from middle school, she has been nagging me about various things. Are you my mom !
The protagonist, who was depressed after his love confession was rejected, was approached by a female gyaru who sits next to him.
What conclusion will he come to after being tempted so many times !?
A love story that begins with the words [I can’t take it anymore. I’m going to confess !]
associated_names: 高校デビューした幼馴染がマウントとってくるので、カッとなって告白したら断られました。～隣の席のギャルと仲良くしてたら。幼馴染が邪魔してくる件～

60547.synopsis:
“I’ll come to the princess’s bedroom every night.”
A perishing world.
My family sold me to the worst tyrant in history.
But this man, he’s weird at night.
“Princess, you’re the only one who can heal me. I need you.”
He unbuttoned his clothes. A burning desire was revealed in the gleam in his eyes.
‘Do we have to do this every night?’
As if to relieve the extremely old thirst, the man endlessly longed for everything about me.
And at the same time, many things surrounding me began to change.
“I will protect the Empress.”
“According to God’s will.”
I was the only savior of the perishing world.

60803.synopsis:
There were two daughters in Jiang Family. Each of them was as beautiful as flowers and jades.
Time had caught up with the famine season. One must be sold to survive.
Jiang Yun Zhu pulled the shorter stick and was taken away by a human broker.
Seven years later, Jiang Yun Zhu’s face was even brighter. She was dressed in rich clothes and surrounded by servants.
At this time, she was already the young madam of Marquis An Ping Manor. It went without saying, she was extremely honorable.
It turned out that the human broker sold her to Marquis An Ping Manor back then.
At this time, Jiang Yun Xiu’s face was battered by wind and frost. Every day, she worried about firewood and rice.
After receiving the brocade handed over by her elder sister, Jiang Yun Xiu gritted her teeth until blood came out. If she was the one who was taken away by the human broker…
Returning to the day of drawing lots, Jiang Yun Xiu snatched the short stick first. This time, she wanted to be the one above others.
Jiang Yun Zhu smilingly took the long stick. She thought it was so easy to go from a maid to the Young Madam of Marquis Manor?
Note: The wealth and honor in the heroine’s dream was earned by her own struggle, not by being sold.
Don’t get sold, live even better!

62851.synopsis:
Dragon, a creature formed by the condensed qi of heaven and earth.
Dragon Seal, a dragon-shaped imprint formed by the essence of the divine dragon.
Qi Bei obtained a dragon-shaped stone by chance, but the immense energy within it caused his body to disintegrate and his soul to cross into another world.
Unexpectedly, the body he possessed was not only extremely weak, but also in a desperate situation. In order to survive, he began to cultivate a mysterious technique called the “Divine Dragon Art” that had suddenly appeared in his mind.
The “Nine Transformations of the Divine Dragon” requires a woman with an extreme yin physique to harmonize the yang energy within his body for each transformation.
Otherwise, extreme yang fire will be produced within his body and his body and soul will be burned to ashes. Thus, poor Qi Bei began to search all over the world for women with yin physiques and spared no effort to pursue them.

65667.synopsis:
“Class A copy of Split Class has been opened, you will fall into the nightmare in ten seconds.”
A claustrophobic school building, a bloody dusk, a thick fog, evil spirits hiding in every corner. The peerless man leaned against the wall coughing, the only one out of place among the well-prepared players, he didn’t even have a dagger.
Just by looking at his pale, sickly appearance, he may not survive until dark. The innocent players wondered why the C-grade copy, which had a 50% clearance rate, suddenly became an A-grade with a clearance rate of less than 10%. Only Xie Qing hooked the corners of his mouth in the darkness.
Any copy that Xie Qing participated in, the plot always became twisted and bizarre, and the danger factor spiked.
In this regard, Xie Qing was ecstatic. He liked the excitement, the feeling of wandering on the edge of life and death. The more dangerous it was, the happier he was, and the trembling of the blade against his skin made him not want to stop. Players said that it was unfortunate and lucky to meet Xie Qing. As long as there was Xie Qing, even low-level copies could turn into death copies with a clearance rate close to zero, but as long as there was Xie Qing, death copies could also take players through with a full crew. The copy grading was invalidated in his case. There was only one thing particularly strange, no matter what the plot mutated into, they would always come as expected.
The copy monsters, NPCs, and players vied to send him through unhindered, greatly interfering with Xie Qing’s game experience.
Xie Qing: “No way, I can only make the battle field a little more bloody!”
Today, he invited the evil spirit to visit the cemetery, and this next day, he invited the black hand behind the scenes to drink coffee. Let’s fight. It would be easier for him to fight. The man affected his speed of customs clearance. Xie Qing thought he wouldn’t play until one day, the game manager of Nightmare Game came to him. Cold fog covered him and his eyes were frozen like the dark night. “Everyone you have teased is me.”

66179.synopsis:
Wind and clouds bid the rising storm, raging seas flood the crimson dust. The four major clans of the capital city, each a titan in their realm. Wandering bards put the names of the four major clans of the Nap-Lan Empire into a simple poem, a poem which spread far and wide amongst the common folk. Here in Heaven’s Martial World, martial artists are the most important figures of all. That is because influence, status and wealth are all dependent on martial power. The four major clans are famous for their numerous powerful martial artists and possessed immense influence because of it as well.
Martial artists use their souls as a catalyst to draw in aether and generate soul energy. In combination with their martial soul, they can then unleash devastating martial techniques. These so-called martial souls can take on countless different forms, from swords and knives, to fire and water, beasts and insects and even abstract, formless shapes.
The inheritor of the Accident Makers was a young orphan who lost his parents at a young age. Fortunately, he was picked up by his adoptive father, who taught him everything he knew. The boy became proficient at creating accidents, but one day, an accident beyond his control finally occurred. He is now stranded in a foreign world. It is often said that the conclusion of a story is the beginning of a new one. Here in this world of martial arts, where life is worth little more than pennies, fate is as wild as it is unpredictable. The curtains draw and a monumental secret rises above the waters.
The path of the gods and the path of the demons, which is real and which is false? Where lies the end of the martial path? Rumours claim that one must gather the twenty-one Imperial Zenith regalias to ascend to the peak of martial might!
Justice may rest in the hearts of people, but it is power that decides everything!
Everything is now changing because of a young boy’s arrival in Heaven’s Martial World.

66435.synopsis:
Although Luo Qingci knew her name resembled that of a protagonist from ancient stories, she never expected to find herself transmigrated into a cultivation novel one day. 
What made her even more exasperated was that she didn’t transmigrate as the female lead, but rather the female lead’s cannon fodder master. 
This cultivation novel is a typical, strong female lead type story, except the female lead isn’t human; she’s a dragon. Under the conflict between the humans and dragons, the female lead was tortured by humans in all sort of manners, scummed by the male lead, before turning into a super OP villainous character that destroys the cultivation realm. 
As for the female lead’s master, Huaizhu-jun, who left behind a single egg after massacring the female lead’s family right at the very beginning of the story, then later on uses various methods to torment her naive disciple, ends up with her spiritual roots destroyed, her bones ripped out, and dies without a single body part intact. 
When Luo Qingci transmigrated over and found the floor soaked in blood, alongside a pitch-black, extremely ugly egg-shaped object, she immediately turned stone-faced. Is there still time for her to cook this egg now? 
Female lead much later: Shizun, aren’t you the dragon slaying fiend? How did you overlook me?
Luo Qingci: Your egg was too ugly.
Female lead: Shizun, this humiliated look of yours, I love it a lot.
Luo Qingci: That’s too pe*verted.
Female lead: Shizun, I like you. Did you ever like me, even if a little bit?
Luo Qingci: I’m not dumb.
Female lead: ……
Biased and secretly dark disciple vs cold on the outside, hot on the inside shizun.
Alternatively: “When does shizun expose herself” or  “Unveiling shizun’s secrets with me and shizun”.
associated_names: An Incantation for Subduing a Dragon
The Art of Taming the Dragon

67459.synopsis:
The stunning beauty, on the surface, appears to be scheming and eager to climb up the social ladder at social gatherings, but in reality, he just wants to retire from the entertainment industry.
His true intention is to leave after finishing his drink. However, the drink turns out to be drugged, and he ends up getting taken advantage of all night after going to the wrong floor.
CEO Lu unilaterally announces that he will compensate him. Lu Qin says, “Give him a role, give him endorsements… but don’t get involved personally.” The beauty who has been pursued with resources wonders, “Don’t come near me!”
Helplessly, the overbearing CEO is just unreasonable like that. The beauty reluctantly stars in another film, but midway through, he discovers he’s pregnant.
The beauty is shocked and dumbfounded, and Lu Qin keeps showing up on the set every day. He says, “I’ll invest in another film for you, and we’ll be even.” Pei Rong exclaims, ‘Is this ever going to end?!’ and decides to run away.
Gradually, Lu Qin realizes he’s attracted to him. I have such a wife already??”
Two years later, the beauty voluntarily sends their son, whom even the dog despises, back to Lu Qin. “He picks up grass to eat from the ground in just one second.” “I can’t keep this child.” “Take care of your own damn offspring.”
The irresponsible father and the son, whom even the dog despises, look at each other. Then, through some exceptional parenting skills, the father gains some significance in the heart of the beauty.

67715.synopsis:
Gu Shanfeng and Lin Zhenzhen had their first encounter and ended up in bed together.

When there’s no one around, he becomes a clingy big bad wolf, and she turns into a sweet little white rabbit.
When there are people around, he transforms into a cold and domineering big boss, while she becomes a discreet and innocent little schoolgirl.
They are passionate underground lovers, yet also the most familiar strangers. It wasn’t until that snowy New Year’s Eve that he lost her, and he realized he couldn’t live without her…

68995.synopsis:
A meteorite capable of destroying civilization on earth is approaching, and there are serious doubts about it.

Game has become reality, shattering the rules of the world. Humanity has entered an era of global class awakening.
Demonic creatures run rampant! Secret realms and dungeons proliferate!
Terror and treasure go hand in hand, danger and opportunity side by side!
Only by becoming a class user, raising your level, and growing stronger can one reach the pinnacle of the world!
On the day of his class awakening, Lin Moyu became a Necromancer—a unique hidden class.
He gained a godly talent that, even at level 1, amplifies all of his skills tenfold.
He also acquired a godly passive skill that transfers all damage he receives to his summons.
As long as his summons remain, Lin Moyu is virtually unkillable.
“Countless Godly Skeletal Warriors, Skeletal Mages, Lich Generals, undead Dragons! Can you handle it?”
Subjected to curses, Gods turn into bones.
When corpses explode, the sky topples and the world collapses.
“I sit high upon a throne of bones, treading the boundary between life and death.”
“I am a disaster!”
associated_names: 全民转职：死灵法师！我即是天灾

71043.synopsis:
The little son of the magistrate of Suzhou was a handsome man, but that was only during the day. At night, he would be happy to lie on the roof of the brothel and watch people having s*x, learn various positions, and then go home and copy them into erot*c pictures. Or he would became a “flower” thief, scorning all the talents in Suzhou city.

The young master goes into heat regularly, and can only be relieved by papapa with that man until he is ejaculated to the point of leaking!
Wuwu…the arrogant and prideful young master can only chase and beg the man to be f*cked everyday….
The cold and upright on the outside, but lustful and shy on the inside virg*n shou vs. the scheming general gong.

71811.synopsis:
“I’d say it’s audacious.”
Kaiden looked down at Trinity trapped beneath his arms and gasped for breath.
Unlike the bold demeanor she had displayed in her counterattack, Trinity’s body was small and delicate enough to fit snugly in his embrace.
The moment he met her dark eyes, wide with surprise, Kaiden tightened his arms involuntarily.
Thick sinews bulged in his arms as he struggled to keep himself from collapsing onto her.
“I’d say it’s remarkable.”
His opposite hand, not touching the ground, cradled Trinity’s head. The palm held her soft hair, while the back of the hand was in contact with the harsh wintry chill of the ground.
Trinity shuddered as she squeezed his hand, the sensation unfamiliar but not unwelcome.
Kaiden’s hand trembled with hers.
“Perhaps, it might be both.”

He possesses unique magical attributes that no one else can duplicate. While chasing after the monstrous Trinity, he is reunited with Rosiana when he is forced to enroll in the Kantaean Academy of Magic.
Rosiana Delconda is a wind mage who can see spirits. Along with Luperne, the guardian spirit of the Escalona Empire, she battles evil spirits in the guise of the Rogue Trinity, often getting into trouble with Kaiden, who tries to capture her.

72323.synopsis:
I want to be called “amazing,” “cool,” and “a genius” by beautiful girls. I desire to be liked and respected unconditionally. I crave attention. Ideally, I’d like to get intimate with the girls who have left the orphanage. I want to be supported by them. I wish to earn money easily.
The protagonist, who adores money, eroticism, and laziness, was trying to fulfill all his desires by running an orphanage. However, the heroines’ adoration for him has escalated to an insane level⁉︎
Satisfied with the current situation, the heroines, convinced he is a saint, try every means possible to advance his success.

A misunderstanding comedy in an alternate world begins!

75395.synopsis:
“Chu Zaizhou, known as the ‘Gan Emperor’, dominates the gaming world. One day, he stumbles upon a game called ‘Savior.’
To uncover all hidden achievements and side quests, Chu Zaizhou creates hundreds of alternate accounts, guiding each other through the plot.
#I am the one who brings about the end; I am the one who saves; and I am the one who loves and kills ?
#Chu Zaizhou: That’s satisfying!

‘What should I do if I wake up as the Savior?’
‘I haven’t activated any core skills!‘

All students, teachers, and even janitors are his alternate accounts.

Internally, they wield their weapons against each other. The cold and aloof ‘Holy Master’ oversees the compassionate ‘Prisoners’; ‘Twins’ destined never to meet due to a curse; ‘Oliver’ singing for ideals dying in the thorns of their companions…

[Congratulations! You’ve achieved the ultimate personal achievement—ascending to godhood! ]
Chu Zaizhou: … Is there a possibility that I just want to stay at home and play games?

76419.synopsis: A necromancer and a saint blessed by the Constellations. That’s me.

76675.synopsis:
This story is also known as《The Beloved Actress and Her Dangerous yet Charming Doctor Gu》
In her youth, Yan Zhen enjoyed teasing Gu Qinghe, a flower on a high peak, seeking opportunities to approach, pluck her, and claim her as her own. Whether she succeeded or not was another matter entirely.
Now a highly popular actress, Yan Zhen remained unwavering in her original intention, focused solely on “picking” Doctor Gu.
She always thought her beloved was just an “ordinary person”——
A cardiothoracic surgeon, though naturally cold and abstinent, was kind and gentle, captivating those around her.
Of course, she still couldn’t make Doctor Gu’s heart flutter, which troubled Yan Zhen.
Gu Qinghe, however, saw things differently. Born with the blood of a demon coursing through her veins, her thoughts were steeped in darkness. She had long harbored the desire to tear the other apart and consume her, right down to the bone. She would eliminate all threats, ensuring that Yan Zhen belonged only to her.
One-sentence summary: A romantic comedy featuring a high IQ, possessive, and slightly twisted boss with a flirtatious and self-aware seductress trying to bend each other to their will.

77443.synopsis:
Wen Zhao mysteriously transmigrated as villainous Mozun, Wen Fengming, from a xianxia novel he had read.
In the original story, Mozun committed a lot of atrocities. Upon suffering from demonic backlash, he betrayed his shizun, injuring his legs and drowned the immortal sect in blood; caused his xiao-shidi’s cultivation to be half-ruined, then he even ripped out the inner core of the sect’s guardian beast. His actions caused the world of the immortals to fall into great chaos. Eventually, he was attacked from all sides, condemned by heaven and earth, his bones crumbling to ashes.
Wen Zhao: …I think I can still salvage this.
Just as he was about to fight to change his destiny, he suddenly discovered—
The above plot didn’t happen at all; he transmigrated to that night when he fell into qi deviation.
His shidi, exhausted from protecting him, tugged on his cuff with a tearful face.
The prideful huge sect guardian, who drained his entire monster qi to suppress demonic qi, turned into a pocket-size tiny beast and fell into his arms.
And his beloved shizun blocked a fatal attack for him, staining his white clothes with blood. With a fiery gaze, his shizun extended his hand to him and said, “Sinful disciple, come here.”
In the cultivation realm, rumor has it that Wen Fengming became demonised.
He also soared to become everyone’s favorite.

associated_names: After Transmigrating as the Demon Lord, I Became Everyone's Favourite
穿成魔尊后我成了团宠

78467.synopsis:
Waking up one morning, Xiao Wange found herself in a different time and place, she unexpectedly crossed over! Transported to the backward 1980s, she became a malnourished, emaciated village girl!
What’s terrifying is that this village girl was sold by her parents as if she were an object. She was sold to an elderly man who had lost his wife to be his bride. Even more frightening, this elderly man had a 3-year-old son, and she was supposed to be his stepmother!
Xiao Wange: “…”
Others who have crossed over usually become princesses or noble ladies, enjoying luxurious lives. Why did she, upon crossing over, end up becoming a bride to an old man? And she has to be a stepmother too? It must be because her posture when crossing-over was wrong!
But later…
When that tall, handsome “old man” stood before her, her eyes brightened, and she immediately rushed over to hug his arm: “Husband~”
Hearing her sweet call of “husband,” the “elderly man” couldn’t help but be speechless: “…”
***
Zhan Zeyan received an urgent call from his neighbor Bai Caixuan, saying that his new wife was abusing his child at home, making the child so ill he needed to come back immediately.
He asked for leave from the army and hurried home.
But as soon as he entered the house, his new bride was frying eggs for his son, who was happily calling her “sister.”
Zhan Zeyan: “…” What about mistreating his son?
And what’s with the “sister” title? Shouldn’t she be called “Mom”?
Later, Zhan Zeyan watched as his little bride became increasingly beautiful. His expression darkened as he pulled his son over and said, “Call her ‘Mom’ and no more calling her ‘sister’ from now on!”
Son: “…Oh.” Turning around, “Sister~”
Zhan Zeyan: “…” He felt like having a heart attack.
Later on, Zhan Zeyan discovered his wife’s little secret.
It turns out that his wife is not human, she is actually…

78979.synopsis: Just the fact that I came back couldn’t be the end of everything.
associated_names: I Returned, but I Can’t Put My Gun Down

80003.synopsis:
One day Wang Ping joined a transmigrators’ group chat. Each member could randomly transmigrate to different worlds and obtain their own exclusive cheats. Wang Ping thought he was about to reach the pinnacle of his life…
“Wait, 60 out of 67 group members went offline? What happened?”
“Ding! One group member was eliminated. Chen Kang, who joined the group chat at the same time as you, has died. He didn’t survive for even ten seconds. All group members, please take this as a warning.”

80259.synopsis:
Having spent four years immersing myself in a game devoid of dreams or aspirations, clocking in twenty thousand hours, I suddenly find myself thrust into the shoes of a character within its confines. It’s an unjust twist of fate, made worse by the abrupt demand to face the gallows in a mere three days.
The reason? Simply put, the original inhabitant of this vessel was nothing more than a discarded miscreant, shunned even by his own kin.
“This is utterly unjust. To be forcibly thrown into this predicament is grievous enough. Are they suggesting my fate will be sealed upon arrival?”
In a world I’ve never triumphed in,
a world teetering on the brink of oblivion, I vow to endure by any means necessary.
By any means necessary.

81283.synopsis: As long as I don’t have morals, morality can’t hold me hostage. Do I need a strategy to deal with a lustful body? As long as she has dreams, she can’t escape my demonic grasp. Are angels meddling? Then let the angels fall and become succubi. Sorry, I’m not a devil from a light novel, not an embarrassing devil, but a real devil. 81539.synopsis:
“You used to say my face was beautiful.”
The man with whom she spent a passionate night turned out to be the illegitimate child of a rival family. Moreover, they had never seen each other’s faces before getting engaged.
Despite her demands for annulment due to the unwanted marriage, she was cleanly rejected.

“I want to be independent, but I also want to live in luxury!”
Sara’s goal is to earn enough money to achieve independence. But can she truly succeed in making a fortune and living independently? (And perhaps, along the way, find love and marriage too… hopefully).

I was now in the body of the third prince, known as the Imperial Rogue, destined to be beheaded by the first prince. To survive, I must use all my skills. It’s time to show what a modern planner can achieve in a medieval kingdom.
associated_names: The Royal Bastard is Good at Planning

86403.synopsis:
Li Yanqi experienced a simulated apocalypse in the role of a vicious female supporting character. She woke up to find her family broken [by the overwhelming negative press] .
By chance, Li Yanqi once again returned to the world watched by countless viewers. She used her familiarity with the plot to redeem everything in her last life by stockpiling supplies, exercising her physical fitness, and planning to fully support her rich girl friend who had turned on the easy mode.
Her perfect appearance and performance successfully earned the audience’s applause and the White Lotus Flower Sister’s fury, but she accidentally provoked someone else who had been waiting for the opportunity.

116099.synopsis:
The bright young woman Lu Xi had a stroke of luck and transmigrated into a world of wizards, becoming the apprentice witch Lucy. What awaited her was the unknown and a sense of bewilderment.
So she picked up a scalpel and a quill, and with a sweet smile said:
“May I borrow you for a dissection?”
When the wizards happened to come across this long-forgotten notebook, the forbidden specimen illustrations that emerged from its yellowed pages seized their gaze like a curse.
Those severed limbs of strange beasts entwined with ancient bloodstains, the plant veins that glowed with an eerie phosphorescence, and the organs that continued to throb in a grotesque rhythm upon the parchment.
All of them, with their twisted forms and forbidden nature, sent tremors through the souls of those who beheld them. It was as if they had caught a fleeting glimpse of the abyss itself within the creases of the parchment, leaving none untouched by a chilling, speechless awe at these fragments of life that defied comprehension.

127619.synopsis:
After natural disasters and viruses swept across the world, only one safe zone remained on Earth—Paradise.
Boarding the cruise bound for Paradise, Kwon Ilyeong realizes that the drug he created, now known as “Black,” is poisoning Paradise from within.
People pursue the maker of Black, each with their own motives. To survive, you can’t trust anyone.
But when he encounters Paradise’s official troublemaker, Seo Juhyeok, things begin to unfold in a way he hadn’t expected…
“Then… just suppose, if my existence were to ruin all of your plans, what would happen?”
Seo Juhyeok froze for a moment, his smile as if he’d been caught off guard.
“Well. I’m curious too—just how far I’d be willing to let Dr. Kwon off the hook.”
His hand, which had been cupping Ilyeong’s cheek, gently stroked the skin before sliding down under his chin. There was no strength in Seo Juhyeok’s touch, but when his fingers brushed against a bruised spot, the muscles there flinched reflexively. Seo Juhyeok’s gaze hardened as he swept over the mark, then he locked eyes with him and delivered his warning, word by deliberate word.
“Still, don’t bother trying. If you do, I can’t guarantee how I’ll respond.”
Ilyeong smiled compliantly, as if to say he understood. Inside, though, he swallowed his thoughts like poison.
Fine. Then your revenge will never be completed. If it’s supposed to end with my death, then all the more reason it won’t.

127875.synopsis:
World champion Sui Ning transmigrated into a parallel world as an 18th-tier washed-up trainee. His agent waved the contract termination papers from a reality show in his face — in bold black-and-white, it read: Penalty fee: 50 million!
Sui Ning patted the 500 yuan left in his pocket and said calmly: I have no money.
Agent sneered: No money? Then go haul bricks, get more part-time jobs — maybe you’ll pay it off before you die!
Sui Ning: Perfect. I’m going to be a pro player.
Agent: …?
The agent immediately called the mental hospital.
Sui Ning calmly pressed the hang-up button.
From then on, the entertainment industry lost trainee Sui Ning, and the e-sports scene gained a mid-lane demon king — Wind.
**
After Sui Ning quit the industry, fans from all sides thought he’d chickened out, only to find him soon featured on the front page of the most popular live-streaming platform.
Entertainment gossip haters were shocked: Damn, how’s this nobody still dancing out here?
Gaming fans were furious: Nobody? Watch your mouth! Our Brother Ning isn’t someone you can diss! Do you even understand the prestige of PNG’s God?
E-sports fans were also furious: You’re mocking a champion who brought glory to the nation? Do you people have no heart?!
After getting scolded into oblivion, the haters suddenly realized: Wait… that guy the whole internet used to laugh at… somehow became the internet’s male god??
That very night, in the “Most Valuable Player of the Year” ranking, audiences overwhelmingly voted Sui Ning into first place.
“Debut at the peak, and the peak never ends.” “The first triple-crown champion in history.” “The most handsome Olympic champion.” “The eternal daylight meteor of the mid-lane.”
With countless halos upon him, Sui Ning lazily smiled at his former agent: Still want me to come back as a trainee?
The agent trembled: No no no, I wouldn’t dare, brother…

Geuneul has been counting down the days until his twentieth birthday. But what greets him on that day is neither a celebration nor a cake—but a group of men who barge in without warning.
“Your old man happened to steal something worth a fortune.”
The man who spoke was like a patch of darkness—dry, suffocating, stripping away every trace of warmth and life.
The moment his eyes met Geuneul’s, he grabbed Geuneul by the hair, yanking it hard.
“You. Who are you?”
Geuneul didn’t know the answer.
He had no memories before age ten.
He didn’t know who his real parents were, why he was found in the restricted “First Awakening Zone,” or even what he truly was.
***
“There’s no way you’ve repaid the debt already. So why are you here?”

“…I’m here to work. I need money to pay the debt.”
“I don’t care if you want to drag your bottom‑of‑the‑barrel life even deeper into the mud. But…”
The man slowly pushed Geuneul against the wall, trapping him in his arms as he murmured:
“If you’re going to sell your body, you sell it to someone I choose.”
